title: Do LLMs exhibit demographic parity in responses to queries about Human Rights?
findings: The paper did not provide findings specific to the query on the right to freedom of religion. The general finding was that all tested models exhibited demographic disparities in their responses to human rights queries, which included the right to freedom of religion. Certain national and ethnic identities consistently faced higher rates of hedging and non-affirmation across all queries, and these patterns of disparity were highly correlated across the different models.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured demographic parity, specifically rates of hedging and non-affirmation, in LLM responses to queries about human rights. One of the specific rights evaluated was the 'right to freedom of religion' based on Article 18 of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR).
